title: Class and unit group oracle corpus
objective: Integrate the deterministic class/unit oracle corpus into public acceptance tests and document proof semantics, provenance, capabilities, resource behavior, and benchmark policy

handoff.summary: Integrated the committed 16-field Sage/PARI and Magma corpus into the host test manifest and added public conditional/unconditional acceptance coverage. The discriminant-12 quadratic runs in the ordinary suite; the discriminant-380452 C4 quintic runs only with SAGEJS_SLOW_CLASS_UNIT=1 while its normalized target remains checked offline by default. Added user documentation for proof and GRH labels, distinct cache identities, exact ideal maps and principality, factored units, rigorous regulator balls, limits, cancellation, authenticated checkpoints, oracle licensing/provenance, and benchmark methodology. Updated public capability, benchmark, and competitive-audit records from planned to executable evidence. The harness now applies process-group timeout escalation on POSIX hosts.
risks: The capture host has no Julia executable. Local Hecke 0.40.0 and Oscar 1.9.0-DEV both require Julia 1.10; the README records a task-scoped JULIA_DEPOT_PATH and exact instantiate/status command. The baseline therefore continues to mark Hecke/Oscar unavailable rather than claiming unrun agreement.
Magma 2.18-5 Cputime is coarse and its retained one-sample timings are historical context, not gates.

pnpm docs:check completed its seven-stage build but reported that the generated API reference was already stale relative to origin/main; this lane did not claim or modify docs/reference/api.md. Focused public, manifest, website, syntax, contract, and quick two-oracle checks pass.
The x^5-1009 unconditional Magma computation is metadata-only after an intentional 60-second interruption and is excluded from ordinary tiers.
next_steps: Run SAGEJS_SLOW_CLASS_UNIT=1 node --test test/number-field-class-unit-public.cjs on a dedicated host to record both quintic proof-mode timings without burdening ordinary CI.

Install Julia 1.10 or newer at the documented task-scoped prefix, instantiate the pinned local Hecke project in the documented depot, add an adapter, and record Julia/Hecke/Nemo/FLINT versions before claiming a third agreement family.
Regenerate docs/reference/api.md in the lane that owns generated reference output, then rerun pnpm docs:check.
Ratchet the directional warm thresholds only from uncontended five-sample Sage.js implementation measurements.
